comment: Read from src/LoudnessMeter.cpp and src/LoudnessMeterEngine.hpp at commit fb01326, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.11.1, alongside docs/Cella_Manual.md written for 2.11.0. The measurement itself comes from the libebur128 library in deps. The manual's account matches the code. The module has no outputs of its own; the Loudness CV expander is the only way to get a voltage out of it. The nine readings on the display are drawn by a display widget rather than by parameters, so none of them can be clicked for help; they are covered by the first line and the notes.
